label: Callout
description: A short, prominent message box with a tone (info, success, warning, critical) that gives readers context about the record, such as "P1 — follow the major incident process". visibleWhen shows it only when an expression over the record is true. Callouts are presentation; to enforce or warn on every write path use a data-scoped rule with a message action.
usage: Use for guidance tied to the record's situation, with visibleWhen so it appears only when relevant.
Keep text to one or two sentences and say what to do next.
Use critical only for situations that need immediate action.
constraints: tone and text are required; title is at most 80 characters, text at most 300.
visibleWhen is a CEL-subset expression over record and user; it must type-check against the entity and may only reference fields the viewer can read.
visibleWhen is evaluated on the server and re-evaluated after each save; it is never a security control.

accessibility.notes: A critical callout that appears after a save is announced once (role=alert). The tone icon has a text alternative ("Warning").

responsive: Full width of its container; the icon moves above the text below 360px.
